resumen: Lifting the heel with the knee straight. With a straight leg the gastrocnemius works at long length, which is where it grows most.
ejecucion: Stand with your weight on the front of your feet.
Raise your heels as high as you can, keeping your knees straight.
Hold for a moment at the top and lower slowly to the floor.
If you have a step, let the heel drop below it for more range.
Hold on to something with one hand if balance is an issue.
matices: The cited trial trained one leg standing and the other seated for twelve weeks in the same people: the gastrocnemius grew 9 to 12 % standing against under 2 % seated, while the soleus grew similarly in both. The straight knee is what lets the gastrocnemius work long.

fuentes.titulo: Triceps surae muscle hypertrophy is greater after standing versus seated calf-raise training
